channel_cn_description: Use a mainland WorkBuddy account with browser authorization. Models are discovered from this account's /v3/config; no quota check is performed.
channel_intl_description: Use an international WorkBuddy AI account with browser authorization. Models are discovered from this account's /v3/config.
model_ids_description: Optional, one model ID per line. When set, only these exact IDs are synchronized. Otherwise discovery follows the account's default-agent roster in /v3/config and merges free/paid lines. Discovery does not call models or check quotas; automatic paid inference is controlled by a separate option.
invalid_model_ids: Model IDs must be nonempty single-line text, at most 200 characters each, with no control characters or duplicates.
auto_paid_on_rate_limit: Automatically use paid lines after rate limits
auto_paid_on_rate_limit_description: Off by default. Enabling authorizes automatic use of the configured paid line, consuming credits, after a free line returns rate-limit code 6004. Switches once only before response output; returns to the free line when the rate-limit window expires.
invalid_auto_paid_on_rate_limit: The automatic paid-line option must be a boolean.
invalid_options: Unsupported WorkBuddy configuration fields were provided.
